description.en: Steer your character in the air during jumps and falls, with the movement keys or the left stick.
description.zh-Hans: 跳跃和下落时，可用移动键或左摇杆在空中操控角色方向。

help.en: Off: the mod does nothing, and your jumps are the game's own again.
help.zh-Hans: 关闭：模组不起作用，跳跃恢复为游戏原本的样子。

help.en: How hard you can steer in the air. Light turns gently, Max turns almost on the spot.
help.zh-Hans: 空中转向的力度。弱：转向平缓。最强：几乎可原地转向。

help.en: On: letting go of the movement keys or the stick in the air keeps your speed. Off: the game slows you down before you land.
help.zh-Hans: 开启：在空中松开移动键或摇杆时，保持当前速度。关闭：游戏会在落地前让你减速。
